Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?

Oh, batting. Achha. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par upar 8 barabar gaps hain. 7 gaps se zyada gaps, toh har ek chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8, bilkul 0 se chipka hua. Achha, ab phir se padhai ki baat karte hain. Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

hmm, achha
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.
